canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators; SHA-256 over the manifest body excluding manifest_sha256
ordering_rule: Sort by the declared canonical row-identity tuple before hashing; serialize nulls and numeric values under a versioned canonical encoding.
phase_rule: Only exact gamePk authority with positive REGULAR_SEASON membership is admitted; all unresolved authority conditions fail closed.
immutability_rule: A manifest and every referenced source/output hash are immutable. Corrections create a new manifest with predecessor and supersession fields; they never overwrite the prior binding.
result_rule: Every result artifact must name exactly one training/evaluation run manifest hash and must hash its own exact input and output populations.
certification_abort_conditions: missing unknown special conflicting or duplicate authority
model or result artifact hash mismatch
result lacks exact parent run-manifest binding
